result.summary: The page is largely well-designed, but there is one clear data/formatting bug: the 'Smash Bros Burgers' card shows '€NaN delivery' instead of a valid price, indicating a failed numeric parse or missing delivery fee value. Other observations are minor cosmetic/truncation items.

issues.description: The 'Smash Bros Burgers' restaurant card displays '€NaN delivery' under the name. 'NaN' (Not a Number) is a raw programming value leaking into the UI, meaning the delivery fee failed to load or parse.
issues.suggestion: Fix the data source or formatting logic so a valid currency value (e.g. '€0.90 delivery' or 'Free delivery') is shown. Add a fallback for missing/invalid fee values so 'NaN' is never rendered to users.

issues.description: The third card in the 'Fastest near you' horizontal row ('Trattoria Piccol...') is cut off at the right screen edge with its title truncated mid-word and no visible scroll affordance or peek padding.
issues.suggestion: Add right-edge padding or a partial-card 'peek' with a scroll hint so users understand the row is horizontally scrollable, and ensure titles truncate gracefully with an ellipsis.

issues.description: The notification bell icon in the top-right has a small red indicator dot but no visible label or badge count, and icon-only controls rely on shape alone.
issues.suggestion: Provide an accessible label (e.g. aria-label='Notifications') and consider a count badge or tooltip so the notification state is clear to all users.
